Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have looked at your request carefully for our shop. We can offer you a price of €36.00 per unit. 

We always aim to deliver top quality from our machines for your orders, and we look forward to working together on this project. Let us know if this works for you.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

sup:70240.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain fully flexible and look forward to building a great relationship together. Let us know if this works for you!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

move.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH team,

You have described Hollerau as an important reference customer; it sounds like this project's value extends beyond the immediate order. We appreciate that relationship and will ensure reliable payment for our purchases. How could earlier payment, alongside the verified reductions in material and energy costs, enable you to sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 28.61 per unit, 30 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

Hallo, you did your homework on the material costs, I have to give you that. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We also checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. With that and the material drop, I can meet you at 30.50 EUR per piece. Our Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

If you can actually pay in 14 days like you mentioned, that helps my cash flow a lot. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €30.00 per unit. This option is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková

move.body:
Dear Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH team,

You have highlighted room for additional work and Hollerau’s value as a reference customer—it sounds like growing this relationship would be welcome. We value your straightforward approach and will ensure reliable payment for the new series. If we accelerate payment, how much room does that create for you to sharpen your price?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,200 units per year for 24 months. That is a contract worth about EUR 152,838 a year. We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0). We have also put our invoice processing in order and will pay reliably on the agreed day. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 93% of your invoices late, on average 11 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 11 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 30.25 per unit, 14 days payment, 28 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
